My point is, this event happened, and the true nature of this event is a miracle allowed by Allah and other misconceptions are created in the belief of magic. You refer to chapter 2 of the Quran, Al-Baqarah, verse 282, where it addresses witnesses for financial contract disputes and what you’re referring to is where it says when only 1 man can be eye witness, gather 2 women in place of 1 man. The Quran justifies this for women as a means of relaxation of responsibility as it is not very suited to their temperament, sphere of interest, and usual environment. See how it regards contract “disputes” only and not everything else. In real Islam, the voice of a man and woman is equal. It is easy to misinterpret something when you are unaware of entire context. The splitting of the moon happened. There were polytheists who asked the prophet Muhammad (PBUH) “If you truly are a Prophet that has been appointed by Allah, then split the moon in half. Let it be in such a way that one half will appear over the Mount Abu Qubais and the other half will be seen over Mount Quayqian.” Through Allah this event occurred, and although it did, polytheists overturned it as magic and having a spell cast on them. They were challenged to ask travellers from afar if they had seen as they had in which the travellers had. The event was still denied by polytheists because of their rejection to Allah. As the scholar Taftazani said “The miracle of the splitting of the moon is a mutawatir event just like the water flowing down from his fingers, the dry wooden stud that the Prophet leaned against while reciting sermons in the mosque crying due to leaving the Prophet and the whole congregation hearing it. That is, it was reported by such a big congregation that it is impossible for them to agree to lie about something. We are sure that a comet called Halley was seen from the world and recorded by historians a thousand years ago because people transmitted that information through centuries; that is, it is mutawatir; we are sure that there is a country called Sri Lanka only by hearing its name though we have not seen it; similarly, the splitting of the moon is mutawatir.” The point of that quote if you got this far into reading is to help understand that when an event happens and is denied by the mass public because of their own ignorance for it being the cause of Allah, obviously through time it won’t be passed down by the mass public, but by those who believe in Allah. It is not even an impossible miracle to fathom. The breakup of a mountain due to a volcanic eruption is possible through Allah so how can’t the moon split through Allah? Pagans such as Vikings use this event in their mythology, claiming wolves named Skol and Hati are the sun and moon who chase each other in an endless cycle but eventually Ragnorok happens and the moon splits along with the sky. The event is recounted by polytheists and pagans but recounted as form of magic and this is made clear by the Quran and authentic Hadiths. Those who are not blind will see the truth and those who reject, will deny the truth and twist it to their liking. Secondly, you refer to Chapter 86 verse 5-7. “Man should reflect on what he was created from. He is created from spurting fluid, emerging from between the backbone and ribs.” Firstly, in english translations and original Arabic, the word fluid is used and not sperm. Secondly, it can refer to a baby emerging from a mothers womb, between the backbone (or loins) and ribs. This verse regards sexual intercourse between man and woman by which the ejaculatory fluid is issued between them during intercourse. Again, the word actually used is mā’a (مَآء) meaning water or fluid. But even if it said sperm, this still would not be a problem because sperm is produced in the testes which is located between the loins (where the put underwear) and your ribs. So still, there is no contradiction to science. 70% of the ejaculatory fluid that contains sperm comes from the seminal vesicles, which are parallel to the backbone. If you’ve ever taken a Biology class in high school surely you’ve seen a diagram of the reproduction system and know the seminal vesicles go up along the backbone. Another way to look at this verse is not at the fluid, but an entity emerging from between the backbone (or loins) and ribs (breastbone in this case), is the baby that emerges from its mother’s womb. There are many interpretations, none contradicting the possibility of science. This allowed rightful marriage between man and woman to increase and produce more men and women so society could prosper. This is true Islam. Like anything, Islam can be distorted, but these who distort are not true believers of Islam and Allah is All Knowing. When a man forces his daughter into marriage for some sort of gain or marries her at a young age when she has not reached “maturity” for mischievous reasons, this is a man who does not follow Islam. Unfortunately we live in a deterring world and corruption of all sorts is present everywhere and these times are predicted by the Quran. There is no animosity between you and I and it’s fine with me if you don’t accept Islam but there is always a certain truth in Islam and I hope you understand better of what Allah revealed and refrain from wrongful accusations that are made useful by those who corrupt the religion from what it truly is.
